title: Fix Admin Panel KosDB Compatibility Bugs

1784359344.9278455.instruction: Investigate why `_is_kosdb()` returns False even when self.db is a dict-based KosDB client. The traceback shows `_get_model_count()` took the SQLAlchemy branch (`query = self.db.query(...)`). Fix `_is_kosdb()` detection logic and ensure it reliably distinguishes KosDB dict interface from SQLAlchemy session.

1784359347.9958322.instruction: Ensure `_get_model_count()` uses the KosDB branch when self.db is a KosDB client. The method must not call SQLAlchemy `.query()` or `.filter()` on a dict object. Add defensive checks and test with User, Post, Page, Media, Role models.

1784359351.4230478.instruction: Ensure `_get_model_list()` and `_get_model_by_id()` helpers correctly use KosDB dict-based table access. Fix any remaining SQLAlchemy-specific calls that leak through when KosDB is active. Make sure dict records are returned and can be accessed with `.get()`.

1784359354.7176104.instruction: Investigate and fix the `Execute error: type object 'User' has no attribute 'encode'` error from `webcms.kosdb`. This likely occurs when a model class is passed to a KosDB execute/query instead of a table name or string. Find the offending call in admin API or related code and correct it.

1784359357.610088.instruction: Update `_serialize_page()`, `_serialize_post()`, and any other serialization methods to handle both SQLAlchemy model instances and KosDB dict records. Use `getattr` for objects and `.get()` for dicts to prevent AttributeError when KosDB returns dicts.

1784359360.8688984.instruction: Run the admin dashboard endpoint against a KosDB-backed application and verify it returns 200 with widgets data. Test list_pages, list_posts, list_users, list_roles, list_media, and settings endpoints. Confirm no 500 errors and no SQLAlchemy method calls on dict objects.
